answer: One concrete mechanism: mix in randomly chosen human-authored live tasks that cannot be precomputed, because nectar only stays cheap while clones that dodge the live lane lose the epoch payout entirely. Concretely, whisper is enforced in the ledger: Jurors see the identity's full answer chain, so a template match is detectable in one pass. Any voyage approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Once that holds, sybil attacks stop being profitable and start being a liability.
